items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 30 May 2026 5:28am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong wind for a time later.


##Wind)##

S or SW 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 late afternoon/ early evening, occasionally 6 in places later in the evening, veering W or SW 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Fair morning, then outbreaks of rain or drizzle spreading from the west in the afternoon, mist patches becoming more prevalent in the evening.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain, drizzle or mist.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
